findings.summary: READY counters were not reconciled against open critical/material findings in the artifact.
Frozen commit/tree and reviewer independence metadata were not bound to Git history and pre-issued review slots.
Artifact paths permitted traversal and request/registry metadata lacked complete schema validation.
The raw review digest made a legitimate metadata-only transition from REVIEW_REQUIRED to READY impossible.
The ledger lock did not protect complete Claim, EvidenceLink, Uncertainty, Source and series history.
Custom package/schema validation could be combined with unrelated canonical review evidence in require-ready mode.
The final ACCEPT, NARROW or REJECT decision and its frozen revision binding were not executable.
The dedicated workflow did not trigger when requirements.txt changed.
Existing semantic corruption tests and frozen #329/#330 isolation passed.

commands: verify remote PR #378 head and all review-scope bytes
run validator, require-ready and focused tests
attempt READY with counters/findings mismatch and fake frozen commit
attempt path traversal and complete-history erasure
conclusion: Two critical and five material fail-open paths prevent READY despite the passing semantic corruption checks and correct frozen package isolation.
